page.overview:
Who is Afara?

Afara is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

After the White Tower Schism, she joined the Rebel Aes Sedai.

Sheriam Bayanar and the Salidar Six send Afara, Edesina Azzedin and Guisin to Tarabon as emissaries of the Rebel faction.

All three were captured by the Seanchan and made damane. Afara was left behind in Tanchico when Edesina and Guisin were taken to Ebou Dar.
